market_read: Week 12 snapshot: 11 verified rows (0 new, 11 persisting, 0 gone), 0 indicative. The market freeze extends to 12 consecutive weeks with no price movements, no new listings, and no confirmed clearances across any monitored municipality. Verified range PHP 269–2,800/sqm; dataset median PHP 2,000/sqm (6th of 11 rows). Pagsanjan-core holds 4 rows (Lambac PHP 850/sqm, Pinagsanjan PHP 1,100/sqm, Sabang PHP 1,500/sqm, Maulawin PHP 2,000/sqm); Pagsanjan-core median PHP 1,300/sqm. Ring municipalities (Pila, Cavinti, Santa Cruz, Magdalena, Liliw) cluster at PHP 2,000/sqm or above, except Pila Mojon at PHP 269/sqm which likely reflects distressed or off-market conditions. The 12-week absence of new entrants or price reductions points to sellers firmly anchored to aspirational prices with no buyer pressure forcing concessions; the market shows no liquidity. The last clearance signal remains the September 14 delisting of Pagsanjan Barangay I (~1.3 ha, estimated ~PHP 700/sqm if sold), unconfirmed as a sale. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, recommended asking range PHP 1,400–1,800/sqm; fastest-sale price PHP 900–1,000/sqm. Aging-versus-cleared inventory remains unanswerable without confirmed sales data.
